verdict.rationale: Extend documents zero data retention options, including ZDR with its AI subprocessors, configurable at the workspace level. If data is never retained, it cannot be reused for model training, so this effectively covers the story. However, no evidence explicitly states that customer data is excluded from training. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party no-training policy or opt-out statement, clarity on whether training exclusion applies by default or only on certain tiers, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
